MEDIA ADVISORY: Governor Kehoe, Cabinet Leaders to Hold Press Conference on State of Missouri's Preparation for U.S. Army’s Planned Ammunition Detonation in Iowa

November 23, 2026

Jefferson City

Today, Monday, November 23
, 
2026
, Governor Mike Kehoe will hold a press conference at the Missouri State Capitol to provide information on the State of Missouri's preparation for the U.S. Army’s planned detonation of materials at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant on Wednesday, which could potentially affect northeast Missouri.
Governor Kehoe will be joined by the directors of the Missouri Department of Natural Resources, the Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services, the Missouri Department of Agriculture, the Missouri Department of Public Safety, and the Missouri State Emergency Management Agency.
The press conference is open to members of the media and invited guests only.
The press conference will be livestreamed for the public on Governor Kehoe's 
YouTube
, 
Facebook ,
 and 
X
 pages.
Monday, November 23, 2026
When: 
2:00 p.m.
Where: 
Missouri State Capitol - Governor's Office (Room 216)
Media: 
Open. Please RSVP with 
Communications@governor.mo.gov

(a mult box will be provided)
